record.paper_title: Open problems posed at the tenth International conference on fuzzy set theory and applications (FSTA 2010, Liptovsky Jan, Slovakia)
record.original_question: For C_tilde_a, the uniform-closure of convex combinations of associative bivariate copulas, determine its extremal points in the Krein-Milman sense. In addition, decide whether every extremal point of C_tilde_a is also an extremal point of the class of all bivariate copulas.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A bivariate copula is a function $C:[0,1]^2\to[0,1]$ such that $C(u,0)=C(0,u)=0$, $C(u,1)=C(1,u)=u$ for all $u\in[0,1]$, and $C$ is 2-increasing, i.e. $C(u_2,v_2)-C(u_1,v_2)-C(u_2,v_1)+C(u_1,v_1)\ge 0$ for all $0\le u_1\le u_2\le 1$ and $0\le v_1\le v_2\le 1$. A copula $C$ is called associative if $C(C(u,v),w)=C(u,C(v,w))$ for all $u,v,w\in[0,1]$. Let $\mathcal{C}$ denote the set of all bivariate copulas equipped with the topology of uniform convergence on $[0,1]^2$, and let $\mathcal{C}_a\subseteq\mathcal{C}$ denote the set of associative bivariate copulas. Define $\widetilde{\mathcal{C}}_a$ as the closure (with respect to uniform convergence) of the convex hull of $\mathcal{C}_a$, i.e. the uniform closure of all finite convex combinations $\sum_{i=1}^n\lambda_i C_i$ with $C_i\in\mathcal{C}_a$, $\lambda_i\ge 0$, $\sum\lambda_i=1$.

(i) Characterize the extreme points of the convex set $\widetilde{\mathcal{C}}_a$ in the sense of the Krein–Milman theorem (a point $C\in\widetilde{\mathcal{C}}_a$ is extreme if $C=\tfrac{1}{2}(C_1+C_2)$ with $C_1,C_2\in\widetilde{\mathcal{C}}_a$ implies $C_1=C_2=C$).

(ii) Determine whether every extreme point of $\widetilde{\mathcal{C}}_a$ is also an extreme point of the full set $\mathcal{C}$ of bivariate copulas.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface a published resolution of this specific question on the extreme points of the uniform-closed convex hull of associative bivariate copulas. While the extreme points of related classes (e.g. semilinear copulas, copulas with hairpin support) have been investigated, no source was found establishing or refuting a full characterization of the extreme points of $\widetilde{\mathcal{C}}_a$ or the embedding of such extreme points into the extreme points of all copulas. Status appears to remain unresolved based on available evidence.

status_evidence.title: Characterization of Extreme Copulas (Ghosh–Bhandari)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies extreme points within the set of all copulas; does not address the convex closure of associative copulas specifically.
status_evidence.claim: Extreme points of the full copula set are studied, but the associative subclass closure problem is not resolved here.

status_evidence.title: Extreme semilinear copulas
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizes extreme points of the convex compact class of semilinear copulas via Krein–Milman.
status_evidence.claim: Analogous extremal characterizations exist for other subclasses, but not for the uniform-closed convex hull of associative copulas.

status_evidence.title: Multivariate copulas with hairpin support
status_evidence.snippet: Copulas with hairpin support are extreme points of the convex set of all copulas.
status_evidence.claim: Known sources of extreme copulas exist but do not settle the associative-mixture extremality question.
